whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Buddha Restaurant & cafe,

I noticed your restaurant has exceptional 4.7★ reviews in the AIIMS-Phulwari Patna area, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and food menu inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, popular food menu categories, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/buddha

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Buddha Restaurant & cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with a mobile-friendly food menu, direct WhatsApp table reservation, and your prime AIIMS-Phulwari Patna location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual restaurant photos aur pricing setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
